title: a16z Podcast: We Gotta Talk Pokémon Go

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Seemingly overnight, a single game -- Pokémon Go -- has taken people by storm.
reader_summary.overview: Seemingly overnight, a single game -- Pokémon Go -- has taken people by storm. But it's a game that was technically years in the making, building on a legacy of creative intellectual property and technologies such as mobile, geomapping/ geolocation. And since "toys are the prelude to serious ideas" [Charles and Ray Eames] or "the next big thing will start out looking like a toy" [Chris Dixon via Clayton Christensen].

key_points.text: But it's a game that was technically years in the making, building on a legacy of creative intellectual property and technologies such as mobile.
And since "toys are the prelude to serious ideas" [Charles and Ray Eames] or "the next big thing will start out looking like a toy" [Chris Dixon via Clayton Christensen].
